content.text: The Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery, which is known as BAMS, is a total of a 5.5-year undergraduate degree program in India. This combines the traditional Ayurvedic methods and practices with modern medicine. The entire course spans 4.5 years of academic study and 1 year of on-site internship. There are a lot of colleges in Uttar Pradesh that offer BAMS admission. So, the scope of career for BAMS in UP is also promising. A total of 100 colleges, including private and government ones, take BAMS admission in Uttar Pradesh. In this article, we are going to cover every details related to the admission process, eligibility, fee structure, and future career opportunities.

sections.heading: BAMS Admission in Uttar Pradesh Overview

content.text: The National Eligibility cum Entrance Test is mandatory for the 12th passed students who are looking into the BAMS course. The NEET-UG qualified students should attend the AYUSH state counselling to get BAMS admission in Uttar Pradesh. There are 6213 BAMS seats available all over the state, where 5600 seats are in private colleges and 613 seats in government ones. The UP BAMS Counselling is conducted by the Directorate of AYUSH, Uttar Pradesh . They are the authority that selects eligible students after a 4 round counselling process. The students can take admission through state quota, all India quota and NRI management quota.

sections.heading: BAMS Admission Process in Uttar Pradesh

content.text: The entire procedure of BAMS admission in UP goes through some selective stages. This includes applying, attending counselling, giving the entrance exam, paying the fees, etc. The following guidelines share the complete admission process in a stepwise manner.

Step 1: The foremost step for the candidate is to apply for the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test(NEET UG) from the official website of the National Testing Agency (NTA). This exam is mandatory, and scoring higher marks enables a higher chance of admission.

Step 2: After the NEET results are declared, candidates then need to register for the AYUSH state counselling session. It can be done from the official website of the Directorate of AYUSH, Uttar Pradesh . Fill up the form with adequate details about your personal and academic information.
Step 3: Next, attend the counselling session online. During this session, the willing students are required to choose their preference for colleges.
Step 4: The counselling authority will publish a list of seat allotment. There, the students are allotted seats as per their NEET merit scores and seat availability at the concerned college.

Step 5: After that, the selected candidates must report to the college. They must produce the relevant documents, both in originals and photocopies. These are required to complete the document verification to ensure authenticity.
Step 6: Lastly, all candidates have to pay the prescribed fees. This finalizes the candidature of the student.

Note: There are a total of 4 rounds of counselling(Round 1, Round 2, Mop-up Round, and Stray Vacancy Round) conducted for BAMS admission in Uttar Pradesh. If no seat is allotted to a candidate in a round, wait further for the next round.

sections.heading: BAMS Eligibility Criteria in Uttar Pradesh

content.text: A set of eligibility criteria is applicable to all the students who are willing to take BAMS admission in Uttar Pradesh. These are given below.
Entrance Examination:

items: All candidates must qualify the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET UG), conducted by NTA and score above the cut-off marks for admission.

content.text: Academic Requirements:

items: Students have to pass their 10+2 examination from a recognised board with having Science Stream(Physics, Chemistry, Biology subjects).
They must score a minimum aggregate of 50% or above in the PCB subjects. (For reserved candidates, it is 40% and for PwD candidates, it is 45%)

content.text: Age

items: The students must be 17 years of age or above at the time of admission.

sections.heading: Documents Required for BAMS Admission in UP

content.text: The Directorate of AYUSH, Uttar Pradesh, has published a list of documents that are required for BAMS admission in Uttar Pradesh. These documents are to be produced at the time of reporting to the college or document verification. Candidates should bring along with them both originals and photocopies of these documents. The list is provided below.

items: NEET Admit Card and Score Card
Class 10th and 12th Marksheets
Class 10th and 12th Certificates
The Birth Certificate

sections.heading: BAMS Course Fees in UP

content.text: The government of India and the Ministry of AYUSH have given the state governments’ independence to provide the BAMS course with their own fee structure. So, the government and private colleges’ BAMS fees in Uttar Pradesh are different.

The private colleges have a higher fee structure than the government ones. Although the private ones charge extra, they also promise the best infrastructure and well-trained faculty.
